dct_creator_sm: Government of New Brunswick, Department of Environment and Local Government.
dct_description_sm:
The New Brunswick Community‑Based River Data monitoring is carried out by local community organizations to help monitor and understand the health of the province’s river systems. Through collaborative sampling efforts and shared stewardship, the program strengthens the province’s capacity to track environmental change and protect freshwater resources. The value of the data and local knowledge collected by the community organizations is essential to the province’s understanding of the state of water quality in the province.

This monitoring program complements the monitoring done by the Department of Environment and Local Government by immensely extending the network of rivers monitored across New Brunswick. These locations are selected by local watershed groups to reflect regional priorities, ecological concerns, and areas of community interest. Sampling occurs multiple times per year and follows standardized protocols to ensure consistency and data quality.
